description: Only for an invoice created with paid checks (["scorechain"], ["merkle-science"] or both) whose analysis.status is awaiting_payment (see invoice_get). Builds ONE USDC transfer of analysis.amount (0.10 Scorechain, 0.40 Merkle Science, 0.50 both) to the Vurto fee wallet (analysis.to), signed by the invoice creator. Sign the charge transaction exactly as returned: it carries the mark that ties the payment to this charge (16 bytes after the transfer arguments on EVM, a memo on Solana). A transfer you build yourself is refused with analysis_payment_rejected, reason charge_not_tied, after the money has left; do not pay again, prove the wallet (destination_challenge with wallet = payer, receiver = details.feeWallet, chargeId = this charge and chargeTxHash = that hash, then destination_authorize) and report the same hash again. Nothing is signed or sent here. The free screening runs first on the receiving wallet and on the creator: a rejected wallet gets screening_blocked (403) and nothing is built; a screening that cannot be read gets screening_unavailable (503). payer must be the creator (the receiving wallet when the invoice was created without a session, which is always the case over MCP); any other wallet gets not_invoice_creator (403) before anything is built. plan has the same shape as invoice_pay (prepare_signing; on Solana POST the signed transaction to /v1/svm/execute), then call invoice_report_analysis_payment with the hash or signature. Paying it from another token is a swap built over the HTTP API (POST /v1/swap on EVM, POST /v1/svm/swap on Solana) from the creator wallet with tokenOut = analysis.token, receiver = analysis.to and invoiceId = this invoice, sized so the guaranteed minimum covers analysis.amountRaw; report its hash or signature to invoice_report_analysis_payment. On EVM only a swap built that way counts (the transaction must match that build); on Solana the Vurto fee wallet must be the only wallet whose USDC rises in it, and it must be the transaction we built, which carries the mark. The minimum must stay between the charge and 10% above it (charge_swap_below_amount, charge_swap_above_amount). A swap that only pays a fee to the same wallet does not count. Errors: no_paid_check, analysis_already_paid, invoice_already_paid, not_invoice_creator, screening_blocked, screening_unavailable. Invoices of the new model (Solana, and EVM networks with a split contract): this is how the PAYER buys the paid analysis of the RECEIVING wallet, with their own money, before paying. Pass payer = the paying wallet and checks (["merkle-science"] 0.40, ["scorechain"] 0.10, both 0.50 USDC, the price of ONE wallet). A new purchase needs no wallet proof, the payment itself proves it; giving it up, changing the tools of an existing charge and reusing a stored analysis do (destination_challenge/destination_authorize for this invoice's receiver; without it payer_signature_required, 401). The free screening of both wallets must pass (screening_blocked 403). It returns receiverAnalysis {status: awaiting_payment, amount, to} and the USDC transfer to sign; report it with invoice_report_analysis_payment (txHash and payer). While it is awaiting payment, invoice_pay refuses with receiver_analysis_unpaid (409): the invoice can be paid only after this analysis is paid and done. checks: [] gives it up before paying. The result comes back without the receiving wallet. Paying it from another token exists on Solana only: POST /v1/svm/swap from the payer with receiver = the fee wallet (receiverAnalysis.to) and invoiceId = this invoice. On EVM the payer pays with the USDC transfer.

checks.description: Solana only: the paid analyses of the RECEIVING wallet the payer buys. [] gives up an unpaid one.

payer.description: EVM (old model): the invoice creator wallet, which signs the analysis payment. Solana (new model): the paying wallet, which buys the analysis of the receiving wallet.
